compiled_state.title: ci-telemetry: finding IDs use template placeholders -> deduplication and tracking broken
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

AWS telemetry shows finding IDs use template placeholders (f-a1b2c3d4, unknown-1-0) that are heavily reused. f-a1b2c3d4 appears 29 times, unknown-1-0 appears 31 times across 324 records. Finding IDs are not globally unique, breaking deduplication, defense matching, and historical tracking.

**Impact**: Cannot reliably deduplicate, track, or match defenses to findings across review cycles

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). Severity=1(medium), Complexity=0(simple-single file), Environment=1(CI), Intermittent=0(deterministic).

comments.body: Investigation complete (BASIC). Root cause: Finding IDs never assigned — agent prompts don't include finding_id in output schema, no pipeline step generates them. Fallback produces 'unknown-{cycle}-{idx}'. When schema doc is in context, LLM copies example value f-a1b2c3d4 verbatim. Fix: add content-hash-based ID generation step in runner.py before telemetry emission.
